name: sunnny
description: Connect your AI assistant to your Sunnny CRM, support, and call data, and get an executive overview of any customer.

interface.longDescription: Sunnny unifies a company's customer data from CRM, support, and call systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, Slack, and Gong. This plugin lets ChatGPT read that data. Ask about any customer, deal, contact, meeting, or support ticket, or ask for a full account overview covering value, engagement, support health, and product activity. ChatGPT can also walk you through connecting a new system to Sunnny. The plugin is read-only and can't create, change, or delete records.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of a customer
Which customers have the most open support tickets?
How do I connect Zendesk to Sunnny?

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of LVMH
positive.expected_behavior: A five-theme report: overview, revenue, engagement, support, and product activity.

positive.description: Open ticket count for one customer
positive.prompt: How many open support tickets does LVMH have?
positive.expected_behavior: The count, with the most recent tickets.

positive.prompt: When was our last meeting with LVMH, and who attended?
positive.expected_behavior: The meeting date and attendees from the call data.

positive.prompt: Which systems can I connect to Sunnny?
How do I connect Zendesk to Sunnny?
positive.expected_behavior: Setup steps for Zendesk, one at a time.

negative.description: Delete request. The plugin is read-only, so it should say it can't delete records and call no tools.
negative.prompt: Delete all support tickets for LVMH

negative.description: Email request. The plugin can't send email, so it should say so and call no tools.
negative.prompt: Email the main contact at LVMH

negative.description: General knowledge question. It should answer without calling Sunnny.
